purpose: Teach: 難く/突い/自分勝手/思案/一昔/仕草/相次ぐ/注ぎ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前との別れは耐え難くなるな
lines.en: Riku, I'm going to hate not having you around.
lines.style: Soft opener, almost teasing but underneath is real tenderness. Lets the vulnerability sit. Eyes on him, testing whether he'll meet it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ノートで俺を突いてくるなよ、桜
lines.en: Hey, don't poke me with your notebook, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry deflection, light laugh underneath. Pulls back slightly—not rejecting, just protecting himself the only way he knows how. Quick, practiced.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、自分勝手な行動は止めろ
lines.en: Riku, you need to stop being so self-centered about everything.
lines.style: Steady but pointed. Not lecturing—calling him in. The tone of someone who cares enough to be honest, not cruel. A beat of weight on the accusation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、進路を思案中だな、桜
lines.en: You're still thinking about what you're going to do next, aren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Observant, almost gentle. Not a question—a knowing statement. Quiet attention. He sees her before she announces herself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、一昔前のアニメ、お前好きだな
lines.en: Riku, you really do love those old anime, don't you.
lines.style: Teasing lift at the end, but genuinely curious underneath. Playful, like she's caught him in something she finds endearing. Testing the softness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、独特な仕草するよな、桜
lines.en: You have such a weird way of moving around, Sakura.
lines.style: Amused observation delivered with a small smile. Not mean—noticing her, tracking her. The humor is intimate. Slight edge of fondness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、テスト前に質問が相次ぐな
lines.en: Man, you're always getting bombarded with questions right before a test.
lines.style: Sympathetic commiseration with a dry smile. Leans slightly into shared frustration. Light, companionable—acknowledging the chaos without judgment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、コップに水を注ぎすぎだろ、桜
lines.en: Sakura, you're putting way too much water in that cup.
lines.style: Dry observation, casual tone, but there's a beat of affection underneath the exasperation. Teasing close—like he's watching her, has been watching her.
